### Art, Poetry & Song: An Evening of Solidarity with Gaza

![Solidarity with Gaza](news/solidarity-gaza.jpg)

On December 13th from 6 to 8 pm, theNCF and Kinvara Solidarity Palestine will host a solidarity event. We will be starting with an exhibition of artworks by children from Gaza, followed by readings from Palestine A-Z and Moon tell me Truth.

### Event Details
- **Date:** Friday 13th December 2024
- **Time:** 6pm - 8pm
- **Location:** TheNCF Collective, 5 Pearse Street, F26 C925
- **Admission:** All Welcome
- **Features:**
  - Exhibition of artworks by children from Gaza
  - Poetry readings from Palestine A-Z and Moon tell me Truth
  - Books available for purchase
  - Kid Friendly event
